description: REQUIRES prior fourinsure__session__login call with same account_link_id. Initialize certificate application history detail.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

cvrc_no.description: Certificate application receipt number (증명서 접수번호). Obtain from certificate.history.list.

group_cvrc_no.description: Group receipt number (그룹 접수번호). Optional; omit unless the history row carries one.

name: fourinsure__b1__certificate__history__detail_init
